Volcano plot

VolcanoPlotter.Rd

Volcano plot

Usage

VolcanoPlotter(
  pd,
  alphaLevel,
  pointColors = c(`Up regulated` = "#276419", `Down regulated` = "#8E0152", NS = "grey"),
  pointSize = 2,
  pointAlpha = 0.7,
  alphaLineColor = "red",
  alphaLineType = "dotted",
  alphaLineWidth = 0.5,
  interactive = FALSE
)

Arguments

pd

Plot data produced by VolcanoData()

alphaLevel

Significance cutoff level

pointColors

Named vector of colors for "Up regulated", "Down regulated", and "NS" points

pointSize

Size of the ggplot2::geom_point()

pointAlpha

The transparency of the ggplot2::geom_point()

alphaLineColor, alphaLineType, alphaLineWidth

Color, type and width of the line used to mark the significance cutoff. See ?ggplot2::geom_hline().

interactive

Whether to plot as interactive with ggiraph::geom_point_interactive()

Value

Volcano ggplot
